contracts.source: Every fixed grant and stat modifier carries the original race/Archetype invocation and recipe/ordinal, atomically persisted. Resume reuses committed identity and grants.

contracts.bodySize: No automatic full lore size, cosmic grant, Raksasa/Machine/Elemental event or extra lineage from the entity name. Primordial body/Size reference profiles remain explicit configuration.
